nodes.title: Worldbuilding Bible, Magic System & Historical Timeline
nodes.summary: Establish geography of Aethelgard, magic system physics, runic languages, factions, and 1,000-year historical chronology.
exit_criteria: Magic system rules contain zero internal logical paradoxes
Geographic atlas and kingdom treaties signed off by lead author

nodes.title: Character Arcs, Psychological Profiles & Dialogue Voices
nodes.summary: Deep psychological dossiers, flaws, desires, moral dilemmas, and speech rhythms for protagonists and antagonists.
exit_criteria: 3-act character transformation arcs mapped for 8 core cast members
Distinct vocabulary registers and speech idiosyncrasies documented

dod_evidence: Character dossiers validated with lead author

nodes.title: Chapter-by-Chapter Novel Manuscript Outline
nodes.summary: Scene-by-scene beat sheet outlining inciting incident, midpoint reversal, climax, and resolution across 32 chapters.
exit_criteria: Pacing curve maintains narrative tension with micro-cliffhangers
Foreshadowing checkpoints verified against climactic third act

nodes.title: First Draft Manuscript Writing (120,000 Words)
nodes.summary: Full prose drafting of the complete 120k-word novel manuscript.
exit_criteria: Word count exceeds 115,000 words across all 32 chapters
All plot threads and subplots resolved according to outline

nodes.title: Developmental & Structural Editing
nodes.summary: Senior developmental editor review for pacing, thematic resonance, character motivation, and plot holes.
exit_criteria: Editor editorial letter addressed through comprehensive revision pass
Act 2 middle-sag tightened and emotional stakes elevated

nodes.title: Line Editing, Proofreading & Sensitivity Read
nodes.summary: Meticulous sentence-level polish for rhythm, grammar, punctuation, and terminology consistency.
exit_criteria: Zero grammatical errors across double-blind proofread passes
World terminology and invented dialect spellings 100% normalized

nodes.title: Cover Art, Typography & Book Typesetting
nodes.summary: Illustrated hardcover jacket, embossed gold foil stamping, custom chapter headers, and interior typography.
exit_criteria: Print-ready PDF passes prepress color gamut (CMYK 300dpi)
EPUB/Mobi digital reflowable layout formatted with responsive drop caps

dod_evidence: Cover artwork and interior typesetting proofs approved

nodes.title: Worldwide Book Release & Audiobook Production
nodes.summary: Simultaneous global launch of Hardcover, Paperback, eBook, and full-cast voice actor Audiobook on Audible/Spotify.
exit_criteria: Ranked on Bestseller lists and shipped across 15 international territories
Audiobook narration master ACX audio quality compliant

dod_evidence: Over 250k copies sold in launch month

nodes.title: IP Copyright Registration & Global Trademark Protection
nodes.summary: Register universe trademarks (Aethelgard, Runeveil, Dawnguard) across USPTO, EUIPO, and WIPO classes 9, 16, 25, 41.
exit_criteria: Official trademark and literary copyright certificates issued
Anti-piracy takedown protocols established

nodes.title: Comic Book Adaptation Rights & Publishing Contract
nodes.summary: Execute publishing deal with major comics publisher (Dark Horse / Image Comics) defining royalties, creator credit, and creative veto.
exit_criteria: Author retains 100% canon oversight and visual character design sign-off
International translation and serialization rights secured

nodes.title: Hollywood Studio Film Option & Purchase Agreement
nodes.summary: Major studio (Warner Bros / Legendary) multi-million dollar film option agreement with guaranteed theatrical release clause.
exit_criteria: Executive Producer credit and approval rights for author secured
Escrow advance disbursed upon studio board approval

dod_evidence: Studio option finalized with Legendary Entertainment

nodes.title: Guild Clearances (SAG-AFTRA, DGA, WGA Compliance)
nodes.summary: Submit contracts to SAG-AFTRA (actors), DGA (directors), and WGA (writers) ensuring union security deposits and minimum standards.
exit_criteria: SAG-AFTRA clearance letter received prior to talent contracting
Pension & Health escrow funding deposit confirmed

nodes.title: Comic Script & Panel-by-Panel Breakdown (Vol 1-4)
nodes.summary: Translate prose into 4-issue graphic novel script with panel descriptions, dialogue captions, and visual pacing.
exit_criteria: Every page contains maximum 6 panels with dynamic camera angles
Page-turn reveal cliffhangers planned for right-hand pages

dod_evidence: All 4 comic scripts approved by editor

nodes.title: Character Model Sheets, Costumes & Creature Design
nodes.summary: Detailed 360-degree character turnarounds, magical weapons, armor schematics, and creature anatomy sheets.
exit_criteria: Facial expression sheets define emotional range for main cast
Costume details reference historical fantasy silhouettes without anatomical clipping

dod_evidence: 24 character and creature model sheets finalized

nodes.title: Rough Thumbnails & Pencils (Volumes 1-4, 180 Pages)
nodes.summary: Full pencil layout drawings for all 180 pages establishing composition, dynamic fight choreography, and eye-flow.
exit_criteria: Visual storytelling comprehensible even without dialogue text
Perspective grids and anatomical proportions verified by lead penciler

dod_evidence: 180 pencil pages complete in Clip Studio

nodes.title: Inking & Final Line Art (180 Pages)
nodes.summary: High-contrast brush-and-ink line art with cross-hatching, varied line weights, and deep shadow textures.
exit_criteria: Clean vectorized line art free of digital artifacting at 600dpi
Deep shadows emphasize grimdark mood and depth

nodes.title: Digital Coloring, Lighting & Ambient Atmosphere
nodes.summary: Color rendering featuring glowing runic magic palettes, moody atmospheric gradients, and cinematic color scripts.
exit_criteria: Color key reflects emotional tone of each act (warm gold ➔ corrupted violet)
Proofed on physical paper stock to avoid ink saturation bleed

nodes.title: Lettering, Sound Effects (SFX) & Balloon Placement
nodes.summary: Custom font dialogue lettering, impactful stylized sound effects (KRRAK!, VWOOSH!), and optimal tail routing.
exit_criteria: Balloons never obscure vital character expressions or background storytelling details
Natural reading flow guides the reader's eye seamlessly across panels

nodes.title: Deluxe Hardcover Print Run & Comic-Con Launch
nodes.summary: Collector's hardcover graphic novel edition printed with ribbon bookmark, foil gilded edges, and SDCC premiere panel.
exit_criteria: 50,000 initial hardcover units distributed to comic shops globally
San Diego Comic-Con signing panel with author and lead artist

nodes.title: Hollywood Feature Screenplay (Draft 1 & Studio Polish)
nodes.summary: 120-page cinematic adaptation screenplay focusing on the novel's core emotional spine, pacing, and setpieces.
exit_criteria: Studio head and director sign-off on Shooting Draft (White Script)
Dialogue and action scenes budgeted for visual effects feasibility

dod_evidence: Studio White Script approved by Legendary executives

nodes.title: Director Lookbook & Cinematic Concept Art
nodes.summary: Comprehensive 150-page visual manifesto: lens choices (Anamorphic), lighting style, color grading arcs, and mood boards.
exit_criteria: Head of Production and Cinematographer (DoP) align on visual tone
Key setpiece keyframes illustrated in photorealistic quality

dod_evidence: Director vision deck signed off by studio

nodes.title: $150M Production Financing & Studio Greenlight
nodes.summary: Official $150M budget allocation, co-financing treaties, state tax rebates (UK/New Zealand), and formal Studio Greenlight.
exit_criteria: Completion bond secured and production bank accounts funded
Official studio press release announcing film production

dod_evidence: $150M budget greenlit with UK Section 48 tax credits

nodes.title: Principal Casting (A-List Leads & Supporting Cast)
nodes.summary: Auditions, chemistry reads, and talent deal negotiations for protagonist, main villain, and mentor characters.
exit_criteria: A-list Academy Award nominee / blockbuster lead signed
Chemistry reads between romantic/rival leads approved by director

nodes.title: Production Design, Physical Sets & Miniature Construction
nodes.summary: Build practical medieval fantasy fortress sets, throne room, ancient catacombs, and miniature castle ruins on studio soundstages.
exit_criteria: Structural engineering and fire safety inspections passed
Sets textured and aged to match director lookbook visual degradation

nodes.title: Location Scouting & International Filming Permits
nodes.summary: Secure permits for glacial mountain ranges in Iceland, ancient Scottish castles, and New Zealand volcanic valleys.
exit_criteria: Environmental impact assessments approved by local park authorities
Base camp logistical access, helicopter landing zones, and emergency medical routes established

nodes.title: IMAX 70mm Camera Package & Custom Anamorphic Lenses
nodes.summary: Procure and bench-test IMAX 15/70 film cameras and ARRI Alexa 65 large-format digital rigs with custom Master Anamorphic glass.
exit_criteria: Lens flare characteristics, edge sharpness, and bokeh falloff calibrated
Dailies color pipeline verified with ACES color space LUTs

nodes.title: Cast Table Read & Rehearsals
nodes.summary: Full cast read-through in London studio, dialogue fine-tuning, and emotional scene blocking with director.
exit_criteria: Dialogue cadence adjusted to match actors' vocal strengths
Final rehearsal notes integrated into shooting script

nodes.title: Stunt Choreography, Wirework & Combat Training
nodes.summary: Sword fighting training, high-wire acrobatic rigging, and practical horse-riding combat drills.
exit_criteria: Zero safety incidents across 60 days of intensive stunt pre-vis
Cast members perform 80% of swordplay choreography safely

nodes.title: Principal Photography — Phase 1: Soundstages (60 Days)
nodes.summary: Shoot interior castle scenes, magical chamber sequences, and dialogue-heavy dramatic exchanges at Pinewood Studios.
exit_criteria: All planned script pages covered within 60 allocated shooting days
Dailies reviewed and approved by editor and director nightly

nodes.title: Principal Photography — Phase 2: On-Location Shoots (45 Days)
nodes.summary: Epic outdoor battle sequences, horseback cavalry charges, and icy mountain expeditions shot in Iceland and Scotland.
exit_criteria: Practical pyrotechnics and hundreds of costumed extras coordinated safely
Natural golden-hour lighting captured for key emotional climax

nodes.title: Pickups, Second Unit & VFX Lighting Capture Wraps
nodes.summary: Macro insert shots, chrome ball HDR lighting captures, LiDAR set scans, and official 'That's a Wrap!' production sign-off.
exit_criteria: All VFX reference metadata, camera focal lengths, and witness camera footage archived
Zero missing coverage shots identified by editorial department

nodes.title: Assembly Cut & Director's Rough Edit
nodes.summary: Assembly of 400 hours of raw footage into a cohesive 165-minute Director's Cut in Avid Media Composer.
exit_criteria: Narrative arc, emotional beats, and comedic/dramatic timing locked
Temp music score and sound effects provide clear foundation for composers

nodes.title: Visual Effects (VFX) Pipeline (ILM / Wētā FX, 1,400 Shots)
nodes.summary: Photorealistic CGI mythical beasts, magical spell effects, digital set extensions, and fluid simulations.
exit_criteria: 1,400 VFX shots completed at 4K resolution with zero uncanny valley artifacts
Creature weight and physical interaction with live-action elements seamless

nodes.title: Orchestral Score Composition & Abbey Road Studio Recording
nodes.summary: 100-piece London Symphony Orchestra recording at Abbey Road Studios with ancient Celtic instruments and choir.
exit_criteria: Signature leitmotifs established for major characters and magical artifacts
Master multi-track stems delivered for surround mixing

nodes.title: Foley, Sound Design & Dolby Atmos 7.1.4 Surround Mix
nodes.summary: Custom magical sound design, blade clashes, dragon roars, and spatial object-based audio mixing in Dolby Atmos.
exit_criteria: Dialogue intelligibility pristine during explosive combat sequences
Dolby Atmos theater printmaster passes certification

nodes.title: Color Grading (ACES HDR Pipeline) & Picture Lock
nodes.summary: Master color grading in DaVinci Resolve Studio across Dolby Vision HDR and DCI-P3 theatrical cinema color spaces.
exit_criteria: Skin tones consistent across all cutaways and lighting changes
Deep blacks preserved without shadow banding on OLED and cinema projectors

nodes.title: Final Theatrical Master (IMAX DMR & DCP Package)
nodes.summary: IMAX Digital Media Remastering (DMR) upscaling, KDM security key encryption, and encrypted hard drive DCP replication.
exit_criteria: Zero dropped frames or audio sync drifts across 100% full runtime QC playback
DCP master certified for worldwide theater distribution

nodes.title: Teaser Trailer Launch & Viral Alternate Reality Game (ARG)
nodes.summary: 90-second atmospheric teaser trailer debuted during Super Bowl / Comic-Con accompanied by interactive in-universe ARG website.
exit_criteria: Over 50 million organic online views within 48 hours of drop
Trending #1 worldwide on YouTube and social networks

nodes.title: Official Main Theatrical Trailer & Soundtrack Single Debut
nodes.summary: 2.5-minute story-driven main trailer attached to major holiday blockbusters, paired with original vocal single.
exit_criteria: 100 million total multi-platform impressions achieved
Soundtrack single enters Billboard Global 200 chart

nodes.title: Global Press Tour, Leicester Square Red Carpet & Festival Premiere
nodes.summary: 10-city international press tour (London, New York, Tokyo, Paris, São Paulo) culminating in world premiere gala screening.
exit_criteria: Rotten Tomatoes / Metacritic review embargo lifts with > 85% score
Live red carpet broadcast viewed by over 10 million fans

nodes.title: Worldwide Theatrical Box Office Launch (4,500+ Screens)
nodes.summary: Simultaneous 4,500+ theater opening weekend rollout including 800 IMAX / Dolby Cinema large-format auditoriums.
exit_criteria: Opening weekend global box office surpasses $120M
CinemaScore audience rating grade 'A' or higher

nodes.title: Home Entertainment 4K UHD Blu-ray & Global Streaming Release
nodes.summary: Deluxe Steelbook 4K UHD release with 3 hours of behind-the-scenes documentary, director commentary, and streaming premiere.
exit_criteria: #1 streaming movie across prime global SVOD platform
Physical Steelbook collector's run sells out in pre-orders
